exceptions.rationale: Trivy reports fix_deferred with no fixed Debian package. The finding is specific to an OpenSSL QUIC server/listener accepting QUIC Initial packets; the production NestJS API is a TCP HTTP service on port 3001 behind the existing reverse proxy and contains no QUIC, HTTP/3 or UDP server wiring. The exception is finding-specific, scanner-specific, time-bounded to seven days, and does not relax CRITICAL or unrelated HIGH findings.

Trivy reports fix_deferred with no fixed Debian package. The finding is specific to an OpenSSL QUIC server/listener accepting QUIC Initial packets; the production Next.js Web runtime is a TCP HTTP service on port 3000 behind the existing reverse proxy and contains no QUIC, HTTP/3, UDP listener, node:quic or OpenSSL QUIC server wiring. The exception is finding-specific, scanner-specific, aligned to the existing short-lived API exception expiry, and does not relax CRITICAL or unrelated HIGH findings.
